image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, grey rocky substrate. The creature has an elongated oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping dorsal plates. The plates feature intricate wavy patterns in white, brown, and red.
